title: Noetherian approximation of a relative global complete intersection
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $n,c\ge0$ integers and $f_1,\dots,f_c\in R[x_1,\dots,x_n]$ [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring] such that $R[x_1,\dots,x_n]/(f_1,\dots,f_c)$ is a relative global complete intersection over $R$ [def-weil-pbc-relative-global-complete-intersection]. Then there is a subring $R_0\subseteq R$ which is a finite type $\mathbf Z$-algebra [def-weil-pbc-finite-type-algebra] (that is, generated as a ring by finitely many elements) and contains all coefficients of $f_1,\dots,f_c$, such that, regarding $f_1,\dots,f_c$ as elements of $R_0[x_1,\dots,x_n]$, the ring $R_0[x_1,\dots,x_n]/(f_1,\dots,f_c)$ is a relative global complete intersection over $R_0$.
